name: Material Design 3 Switch
summary: Google Material Design 3 switch for React and Tailwind with spring physics and haptic audio.
description: A React and Tailwind CSS implementation of the Google Material Design 3 switch: cubic-bezier spring curves for the signature overshoot motion, and a handle that morphs in size and shape between unchecked, checked and pressed states. Haptic feedback comes from a built-in Web Audio engine that synthesises a mechanical thud or plastic click with no audio assets. Custom React node icons, destructive and compact options, 48px touch targets at WCAG AAA.
contains: Material Design 3 switch for React and Tailwind CSS
spring physics overshoot with custom cubic-bezier curves
handle morphs across unchecked, checked and pressed states
Web Audio haptic sound engine, no mp3 assets
custom React node icons, destructive and compact options
